for lam in [1e-3,1e-1,10,100]:
    G=X1.T@X1+lam*np.eye(65); G[-1,-1]-=lam

import numpy as np, time
code = r'''
import numpy as np
from scipy.special import erf
exec(open('model.py').read())
A=Model('A.npz');B=Model('B.npz')
def lnf(x,w,b):
    m=x.mean(-1,keepdims=True); s=np.sqrt(((x-m)**2).mean(-1,keepdims=True)+1e-5)
    xh=(x-m)/s; return xh*w+b,(xh,s,w)
def lnb(dy,c):
    xh,s,w=c; dx=dy*w
    return (dx-dx.mean(-1,keepdims=True)-xh*(dx*xh).mean(-1,keepdims=True))/s
def blk_f(r,k):
    P=lambda n:B.p[f"blocks.{k}.{n}"]; N,T,d=r.shape; H=4; hd=d//H
    y,c1=lnf(r,P("ln1.weight"),P("ln1.bias"))
    sp=lambda z:z.reshape(N,T,H,hd).transpose(0,2,1,3)
    q=sp(y@P("attn.query_proj.weight").T);kk=sp(y@P("attn.key_proj.weight").T);v=sp(y@P("attn.value_proj.weight").T)
    a=q@kk.transpose(0,1,3,2)/np.sqrt(hd)+np.triu(np.full((T,T),-1e30),1)
    a=np.exp(a-a.max(-1,keepdims=True)); a/=a.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    o=(a@v).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(N,T,d)
    r1=r+o@P("attn.out_proj.weight").T
    y2,c2=lnf(r1,P("ln2.weight"),P("ln2.bias"))
    h=y2@P("fc1.weight").T+P("fc1.bias"); g=0.5*h*(1+erf(h/np.sqrt(2)))
    return r1+g@P("fc2.weight").T+P("fc2.bias"),(c1,q,kk,v,a,o,c2,h,k)
def blk_b(dr2,cache):
    c1,q,kk,v,a,o,c2,h,k=cache; P=lambda n:B.p[f"blocks.{k}.{n}"]
    N,T,H,hd=q.shape[0],q.shape[2],4,q.shape[3]; d=H*hd
    dg=dr2@P("fc2.weight"); dh=dg*(0.5*(1+erf(h/np.sqrt(2)))+h*np.exp(-h*h/2)/np.sqrt(2*np.pi))
    dr1=dr2+lnb(dh@P("fc1.weight"),c2)
    do=(dr1@P("attn.out_proj.weight")).reshape(N,T,H,hd).transpose(0,2,1,3)
    dA=do@v.transpose(0,1,3,2); dv=a.transpose(0,1,3,2)@do
    dS=a*(dA-(dA*a).sum(-1,keepdims=True))/np.sqrt(hd)
    dq=dS@kk; dk=dS.transpose(0,1,3,2)@q
    mg=lambda z:z.transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(N,T,d)
    dy=mg(dq)@P("attn.query_proj.weight")+mg(dk)@P("attn.key_proj.weight")+mg(dv)@P("attn.value_proj.weight")
    return dr1+lnb(dy,c1)
def loss_grad(r,tp):
    r3,ca=blk_f(r,2); r4,cb=blk_f(r3,3)
    y,cf=lnf(r4,B.p["lnf.weight"],B.p["lnf.bias"]); L=y@B.p["head.weight"].T+B.p["head.bias"]
    L=L-L.max(-1,keepdims=True); lp=L-np.log(np.exp(L).sum(-1,keepdims=True))
    n=r.shape[0]*r.shape[1]; loss=-(tp*lp).sum()/n
    dL=(np.exp(lp)-tp)/n
    dr=lnb(dL@B.p["head.weight"],cf); dr=blk_b(blk_b(dr,cb),ca)
    return loss,dr,lp
def teacher(W):
    L=B.top(B.r2(W)); L=L-L.max(-1,keepdims=True); p=np.exp(L); return p/p.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
'''
open('bp.py','w').write(code); exec(code)

**How it was built:**
1. **Forward pass:** I implemented both models in numpy and checked them on Python text I wrote myself. A and B scored 73% and 73% on my hand-written code, and about 65% on generated code.
